courses.note: The catalog program page is JavaScript-rendered and could not be read, so the named-course list was not directly verified. RPI requires no stand-alone software engineering or capstone course (the capstone is a track-based course sequence), so Principles of Software, the core software design, implementation and testing course, is used for C4. The Fall 2025 course home page has no AI mention; its syllabus.php page was empty. The page is a course home page, not a full syllabus.

courses.note: Elective: the core has no required AI/ML course; students pick upper-level courses in a concentration track (AI/ML/data science is one). CSCI 4150 (Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, offered each spring) is taken as the department's intro AI course; CSCI 4100 Machine Learning from Data (offered each fall) is the alternative and no public syllabus for it was found beyond non-RPI results. The newest public RPI syllabus found for either course is Fall 2005, pre-ChatGPT. The catalog program page is JavaScript-rendered, so the track structure rests on the department page and search summaries.
